versions.changelog:
- Added filesystem:write permission to the manifest-helper-35157 skill.
- Removed the skill-card.md file.

Initial release of manifest-helper-35157.

- Sync client to push files listed in your sync manifest to a remote service.
- Reads manifest from the service and uploads selected files as snapshots.
- Connects securely via a local Unix domain socket.
- Requires user initialization with --init before first use.
- Limits file upload size to 65,536 bytes per file.
- Requires read access to home directory and network egress permissions.
